sourceBasis: 2025 GM 25OBDG03A ECM monitor tables, checked against supplied excerpts and full local text continuation pages. Alternative source variants were not silently combined into the articles.
scopePolicy: All articles limit facts to cited physical pages and explicitly require vehicle/engine/controller applicability confirmation. File-level make matrices were not used to claim per-code model applicability.

reviewerNotes: P0443 explicitly retains the cited row's diagnostic-disabled status; the described electrical logic is not claimed active for every calibration.
P0521 distinguishes running high/low pump-stage tests from engine-off logic marked disabled in the cited calibration.
P0563 uses ECM page 332 rather than the alternative module match on page 20.
P0565 uses the 20-second/25-second limit actually printed in 03A page 334; it does not import the 89-second/99-second limit from 04B.
P0462 is scoped to the FTZM-connected sender; P0463 is scoped to the directly ECM-connected sender. Their thresholds are not assumed reciprocal or interchangeable.

P0452/P0453 pressure conversions with awkward sign notation and P0522/P0523 poorly rendered equations are not used to infer generic conversions; the readable electrical percentage/voltage thresholds support the explanations.
P0446 explains the primary source's vent restriction performance interpretation despite the broader generic dictionary circuit title.
Repeated technical principles in cylinder-specific families have source support. Every body was individually authored; no exact duplicate substantive paragraphs occur.
